newsitem.title: USA: Mendocino Brewing plans 600,000 shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Mendocino Brewing plans 600,000 shr offer.

text.p: Mendocino Brewing Co said it is offering for sale to the public 600,000 shares of common stock at a price of $8.50 per share.
The shares are offered by the company directly to the public with a minimum purchase price of 50 shares, the company said.

Mendocino Brewing Co operates the Hopland Brewery brewpub and an 18,000 barrel per year production facility in Hopland, the company said. The company's brands include Red Tail Ale, Blue Heron Pale Ale, Black Hawk Stout and Eye of the Hawk Select Ale, the company said.
Shareholders of record as of October 25, 1996, have the first right to purchase the new shares, the company said. The priority right expires Saturday, February 22, 1997, Mendocino said.
The prospectus and the subscription agreement will be available on the company's website at http://mendobrew.com, Mendocino Brewing said.
